label: select
example: SELECT id, name FROM dbunny_snippet_t WHERE id = 1

label: update
example: UPDATE dbunny_snippet_t SET name = 'b' WHERE id = 1

label: with
example: WITH x AS (SELECT id FROM dbunny_snippet_t) SELECT id FROM x

label: case
example: SELECT CASE WHEN id > 0 THEN 'a' ELSE 'b' END FROM dbunny_snippet_t

label: join
example: SELECT * FROM dbunny_snippet_t a JOIN dbunny_snippet_t b ON a.id = b.id

label: upsert
template:
INSERT INTO ${table} (${key}, ${column}) VALUES (${values}) AS new
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ${column} = new.${column}
example: INSERT INTO dbunny_snippet_t (id, name) VALUES (1, 'a') AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = new.name

label: create table
example: CREATE TABLE dbunny_snippet_new (id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(50))
